definition_en: existing or happening before, holding a position before, or the first of two things mentioned
core_image: 旧照片里那栋已经拆掉的老房子
scene: 他是这家公司的前任经理。He is the former manager of the company.
sceneCN: 这里 former 是「前任的」（第 2 个义项）；句意：他是这家公司的前任经理。

senses.title: In earlier times
senses.definition: existing or happening in an earlier period
senses.definitionCN: 存在于或发生在较早时期
senses.example: The former factory is now a museum.
senses.exampleCN: 以前的工厂现在是博物馆。
senses.why: This is the broad time sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是宽泛的时间义项。

senses.title: Previous holder
senses.definition: having held a position before the present one
senses.definitionCN: 在现任之前担任过某职位
senses.example: He is the former manager of the company.
senses.exampleCN: 他是这家公司的前任经理。
senses.why: A role can be left behind.
senses.whyCN: 职位是可以被留在身后的。

senses.title: The first of two
senses.definition: the first of two things just mentioned
senses.definitionCN: 刚提到的两件事中的第一件
senses.example: Of tea and coffee, I prefer the former.
senses.exampleCN: 茶和咖啡之中，我更喜欢前者。
senses.why: A small grammatical sense with a big role.
senses.whyCN: 一个语法义项很小，作用却很大。

intro.en: Former began as a word for the first of two.
intro.cn: former 最初是表示两者中前一个的词。

items.en: Forma meant first.
items.cn: forma 意为第一。

items.en: Former meant earlier or first.
items.cn: former 意为较早的或第一的。

items.en: It came to mean previous in time.
items.cn: 它逐渐表示时间上在先的。

items.en: The phrase the former named the first of two.
items.cn: the former 用来指两者中的前者。

items.en: It also described a previous holder of a post.
items.cn: 它也用来描述曾任某职位的人。

note.en: Former is compared with similar-looking words and with words for what came before.
note.cn: 把 former 与形近词以及表示先前之事的词作比较。

normalIntro.en: Former points backward at what used to be.
normalIntro.cn: former 指向身后那个曾经存在的事物。

normal.en: The former factory is now a museum.
normal.cn: 以前的工厂现在是博物馆。

normal.en: He is the former manager of the company.
normal.cn: 他是这家公司的前任经理。

normal.en: Of tea and coffee, I prefer the former.
normal.cn: 茶和咖啡之中，我更喜欢前者。

normal.en: She met a former colleague at the station.
normal.cn: 她在车站遇到一位前同事。

normal.en: In former times, this road was a river.
normal.cn: 从前这条路是一条河。

abstract.en: The former is the shadow the present casts behind.
abstract.cn: 前者是现在投在身后的影子。

abstract.en: A former home still knows your footsteps.
abstract.cn: 旧居仍然认得你的脚步。

abstract.en: Titles change hands; the word former stays.
abstract.cn: 头衔会易主，而 former 这个词留下。

examples.en: He is the former manager of the company.
examples.cn: 他是这家公司的前任经理。

examples.en: The former factory is now a museum.
examples.cn: 以前的工厂现在是博物馆。

examples.en: Of tea and coffee, I prefer the former.
examples.cn: 茶和咖啡之中，我更喜欢前者。

dict_mnemonic.text: former 来自表示「第一」的古词：两个东西里排第一的是前者，时间上排在前面的就是以前。

root: 源自古英语 forma（第一）的比较级，核心义「在时间或顺序上靠前的」。

sensesIntro.en: Former means earlier, previous in a role, or the first of two.
sensesIntro.cn: former 意为以前的、前任的或前者的。

core.en: What stands before now in time or order.
core.cn: 在时间或顺序上位于现在之前的事物。

branches.en: An old building outlives its use.
branches.cn: 老建筑比它的用途活得更久。

branches.en: A manager steps down.
branches.cn: 经理卸任了。

branches.en: Two choices put one first.
branches.cn: 两个选择让其中一个排在前面。

branches.en: Old things and old roles both remain former.
branches.cn: 旧物与旧职位都保留着 former 的身份。

branches.en: The first of two and the previous holder share the word.
branches.cn: 两者中的前者与前任共享这个词。

intro.en: Former builds a small family of past and position words.
intro.cn: former 构成表示过去与职位的词族。

latinIntro.en: Former is Germanic; Latin pristinus, former, is only a semantic parallel.
latinIntro.cn: former 属日耳曼语；拉丁语 pristinus（以前的）只是语义对应词。

items.example: The former owner left a note.
items.exampleCN: 前房主留下了一张便条。

items.meaning: people who form or shaped things

items.example: The former president wrote a book.

items.meaning: someone who used to work with you
items.exampleCN: 一位前同事给我打了电话。

items.meaning: a place where one used to live

items.example: Life in former times was slower.

definition_en: a mathematical rule, a list of ingredients, a fixed method, or a plan for agreement
core_image: 黑板上写满符号，一条等式把未知变成已知
scene: 这个公式能算出圆的面积。This formula gives the area of a circle.
sceneCN: 这里 formula 是「公式」（第 1 个义项）；句意：这个公式能算出圆的面积。

senses.title: A mathematical rule
senses.definition: a rule expressed in symbols
senses.definitionCN: 用符号表达的规则
senses.example: This formula gives the area of a circle.
senses.exampleCN: 这个公式能算出圆的面积。
senses.why: This is the central scientific sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是核心的科学义项。

senses.title: A recipe
senses.definition: a list of ingredients for making something
senses.definitionCN: 制作某物所需的成分清单
senses.example: The company keeps its formula secret.
senses.exampleCN: 公司对配方保密。
senses.why: A recipe is a formula for food or drink.
senses.whyCN: recipe 就是食品或饮料的公式。

senses.title: A fixed method
senses.definition: a fixed way of doing something that works
senses.definitionCN: 一种固定且有效的做事方式
senses.example: Hard work is no simple formula for success.
senses.exampleCN: 努力并不是成功的简单公式。
senses.why: The word extends from science to life.
senses.whyCN: 这个词从科学延伸到生活。

senses.title: A plan for agreement
senses.definition: a proposed set of terms for solving a problem
senses.definitionCN: 为解决某问题提出的条款方案
senses.example: The two sides agreed on a peace formula.
senses.exampleCN: 双方就和平方案达成一致。
senses.why: Politics borrows the idea of a recipe.
senses.whyCN: 政治借用了配方的概念。

intro.en: Formula is a small form, literally a little shape.
intro.cn: formula 字面意思是「小形状」，是 forma 的指小形式。

items.en: Formula meant a small form or draft.
items.cn: formula 意为小形状或草稿。

items.en: Roman law used formulae as fixed words.
items.cn: 罗马法用固定套语作为公式。

items.en: Mathematics adopted formula in the seventeenth century.
items.cn: 数学在十七世纪采用了 formula。

items.en: Chemistry used it for the recipe of a compound.
items.cn: 化学用它表示化合物的组成。

items.en: Modern life made it a word for any working method.
items.cn: 现代生活使它成为表示任何有效方法的词。

note.en: Formula is compared with similar-looking words and with words for rules and recipes.
note.cn: 把 formula 与形近词以及表示规则和配方的词作比较。

entries.definition: a statement that two amounts are equal
a fixed way of doing something

normalIntro.en: A formula is a recipe written in symbols or in life.
normalIntro.cn: formula 是用符号或生活写成的配方。

normal.en: This formula gives the area of a circle.
normal.cn: 这个公式能算出圆的面积。

normal.en: The company keeps its formula secret.
normal.cn: 公司对配方保密。

normal.en: Hard work is no simple formula for success.
normal.cn: 努力并不是成功的简单公式。

normal.en: The two sides agreed on a peace formula.
normal.cn: 双方就和平方案达成一致。

normal.en: The baby needs a special formula.
normal.cn: 这个婴儿需要特殊配方奶粉。

abstract.en: A formula is a shortcut written by someone who once got lost.
abstract.cn: 公式是曾经迷路的人写下的捷径。

abstract.en: Recipes and equations both promise a repeatable result.
abstract.cn: 食谱和等式都承诺可重复的结果。

abstract.en: No formula can hold a whole life.
abstract.cn: 没有公式能装下一整个人生。

examples.en: This formula gives the area of a circle.
examples.cn: 这个公式能算出圆的面积。

examples.en: The company keeps its formula secret.
examples.cn: 公司对配方保密。

examples.en: The two sides agreed on a peace formula.
examples.cn: 双方就和平方案达成一致。

dict_mnemonic.text: formula 是 form 的小称：一个小而固定的形状，后来成为算题、做菜、做事都可以套用的公式。

root: 源自拉丁语 formula（小形状、固定套语），核心义「固定成形的规则或配方」。

sensesIntro.en: Formula means a math rule, a recipe, a fixed method, or a plan for agreement.
sensesIntro.cn: formula 意为公式、配方、准则或方案。

core.en: A fixed pattern that produces a result.
core.cn: 能产生结果的固定模式。

branches.en: Symbols describe a rule.
branches.cn: 符号描述一条规则。

branches.en: Ingredients follow a recipe.
branches.cn: 成分遵循一个配方。

branches.en: A method can be repeated.
branches.cn: 方法可以被重复。

branches.en: A plan gives politics its terms.
branches.cn: 方案为政治提供条款。

branches.en: Equations and recipes share one structure.
branches.cn: 等式与食谱共享同一种结构。

intro.en: Formula builds a family of fixed-rule words.
intro.cn: formula 构成表示固定规则的词族。

latinIntro.en: Formula comes from Latin formula; the Latin entry below shows that source.
latinIntro.cn: formula 来自拉丁语 formula；下面的拉丁条目展示了这一来源。

items.example: The formula is easy to use.

items.exampleCN: 这本书列出了有用的公式。
他们制定了一个清晰的计划。

items.meaning: the act of expressing or planning
items.example: The formulation of the rule took weeks.
items.exampleCN: 规则的制定花了好几周。
这篇讲话听起来很公式化。

items.example: Write the chemical formula for water.

latinEntries.example: Formula is the Latin source of formula.
latinEntries.exampleCN: formula 是该词的拉丁语来源。

definition_zh: 向前；向外；出来；从某时起
definition_en: forward, outward, out from a place, or onward from a point in time
core_image: 门被推开，一个人从屋里走到阳光下
scene: 他走上前去说明情况。He came forth to explain.
sceneCN: 这里 forth 是「向前」（第 1 个义项）；句意：他走上前去说明情况。

senses.title: Forward
senses.definition: forward in space
senses.definitionCN: 在空间上向前
senses.example: He came forth to explain.
senses.exampleCN: 他走上前去说明情况。
senses.why: This is the core directional sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是核心的方向义项。

senses.title: Outward
senses.definition: out from a place or into view
senses.definitionCN: 从某处出来或进入视线
senses.example: The sun broke forth from the clouds.
senses.exampleCN: 太阳从云层中透出来。
senses.why: Light and sound also move outward.
senses.whyCN: 光和声音也会向外传播。

senses.title: Into being
senses.definition: used with verbs to mean producing or appearing
senses.definitionCN: 与动词连用表示产生或出现
senses.example: The tree brought forth new leaves.
senses.exampleCN: 这棵树长出新叶。
senses.why: A thing can come forth into existence.
senses.whyCN: 事物可以产生出来。

senses.title: Onward in time
senses.definition: onward from a point in time
senses.definitionCN: 从某个时间点往后
senses.example: From that day forth, he walked to work.
senses.exampleCN: 从那天起，他步行上班。
senses.why: Space and time share the same direction.
senses.whyCN: 空间与时间共享同一个方向。

intro.en: Forth is an old Germanic word for forward.
intro.cn: forth 是一个表示向前的古老日耳曼语词。

items.en: Forth meant forward or onward.
items.cn: forth 意为向前或继续向前。

items.en: It was used with verbs of moving and bringing.
items.cn: 它常与移动和带来的动词连用。

items.en: Set forth came to mean to explain.
items.cn: set forth 逐渐表示阐述。

items.en: Back and forth described repeated movement.
items.cn: back and forth 描述反复移动。

items.en: The word became rare alone but lives in phrases.
items.cn: 这个词单独使用变少，却活在短语里。

note.en: Forth is compared with similar-looking words and with words for direction.
note.cn: 把 forth 与形近词以及表示方向的词作比较。

normalIntro.en: Forth is the door opening toward the outside world.
normalIntro.cn: forth 是一扇朝外部世界打开的门。

normal.en: He came forth to explain.
normal.cn: 他走上前去说明情况。

normal.en: The sun broke forth from the clouds.
normal.cn: 太阳从云层中透出来。

normal.en: The tree brought forth new leaves.
normal.cn: 这棵树长出新叶。

normal.en: From that day forth, he walked to work.
normal.cn: 从那天起，他步行上班。

normal.en: She paced back and forth.
normal.cn: 她来回踱步。

abstract.en: Forth is motion that refuses to stay hidden.
abstract.cn: forth 是不肯继续隐藏的运动。

abstract.en: Words set forth become shared.
abstract.cn: 被阐述出来的话就变成共有的。

abstract.en: Time also moves forth, one day at a time.
abstract.cn: 时间也一天一天地向前走。

examples.en: He came forth to explain.
examples.cn: 他走上前去说明情况。

examples.en: The sun broke forth from the clouds.
examples.cn: 太阳从云层中透出来。

examples.en: From that day forth, he walked to work.
examples.cn: 从那天起，他步行上班。

dict_mnemonic.text: forth 和 forward 是亲戚：都表示向前、向外，只是 forth 更古老，也更常躲在短语里。

root: 源自古英语 forth（向前），核心义「朝外、朝前离开原位」。

sensesIntro.en: Forth means forward, outward, into being, or onward in time.
sensesIntro.cn: forth 意为向前、向外、出来或从某时起。

core.en: Movement away from a starting point.
core.cn: 离开起点的运动。

branches.en: A person steps forward.
branches.cn: 一个人向前迈步。

branches.en: Light leaves the clouds.
branches.cn: 光离开云层。

branches.en: Leaves come into being.
branches.cn: 叶子生长出来。

branches.en: A routine begins and continues.
branches.cn: 一种习惯开始并继续。

branches.en: Space and time both move outward.
branches.cn: 空间与时间都向外延伸。

intro.en: Forth gathers a family of forward and immediate words.
intro.cn: forth 聚拢了表示向前与立即的词族。

latinIntro.en: Forth is Germanic; Latin porro, forward, is only a semantic parallel.
latinIntro.cn: forth 属日耳曼语；拉丁语 porro（向前）只是语义对应词。

items.exampleCN: 即将出版的那本书很短。

items.meaning: moving one way and then the other
items.example: The boat rocked back and forth.
Bring pens, paper, and so forth.
The rules are set forth below.
The plan brought forth new ideas.
items.exampleCN: 这个计划产生了新想法。

definition_zh: 两星期；十四天；两周假期
definition_en: a period of two weeks, or a two-week break
core_image: 日历上十四个格子被一条线连在一起
scene: 我们两周后见面。We will meet in a fortnight.
sceneCN: 这里 fortnight 是「两星期」（第 1 个义项）；句意：我们两周后见面。

senses.title: Two weeks
senses.definition: a period of fourteen days
senses.definitionCN: 十四天的一段时间
senses.example: We will meet in a fortnight.
senses.exampleCN: 我们两周后见面。
senses.why: This is the basic British time sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是基本的英式时间义项。

senses.title: Every two weeks
senses.definition: used for events that happen every two weeks
senses.definitionCN: 用于每两周发生一次的事
senses.example: The club meets every fortnight.
senses.exampleCN: 俱乐部每两周聚会一次。
senses.why: A length of time becomes a rhythm.
senses.whyCN: 一段时间变成一种节奏。

senses.title: A two-week break
senses.definition: a holiday lasting two weeks
senses.definitionCN: 持续两周的假期
senses.example: They took a fortnight's holiday.
senses.exampleCN: 他们休了两周假。
senses.why: British speech measures holidays in fortnights.
senses.whyCN: 英式英语用两星期来衡量假期。

intro.en: Fortnight is a contraction of fourteen nights.
intro.cn: fortnight 是 fourteen nights（十四个夜晚）的缩合。

items.en: Feowertyne niht meant fourteen nights.
items.cn: feowertyne niht 意为十四个夜晚。

items.en: The phrase shrank to fourtenight.
items.cn: 这个短语缩略为 fourtenight。

items.en: It settled as fortnight in spelling.
items.cn: 拼写固定为 fortnight。

items.en: British English kept it as the normal word for two weeks.
items.cn: 英式英语把它保留为两星期的常用词。

items.en: It also came to name a two-week holiday.
items.cn: 它也开始表示两周假期。

note.en: Fortnight is compared with similar-looking words and with words for time periods.
note.cn: 把 fortnight 与形近词以及表示时段的词作比较。

normalIntro.en: A fortnight is fourteen nights tied into one word.
normalIntro.cn: fortnight 是十四个夜晚捆成的一个词。

normal.en: We will meet in a fortnight.
normal.cn: 我们两周后见面。

normal.en: The club meets every fortnight.
normal.cn: 俱乐部每两周聚会一次。

normal.en: They took a fortnight's holiday.
normal.cn: 他们休了两周假。

normal.en: She returned a fortnight later.
normal.cn: 她两周后回来了。

normal.en: The letter arrived a fortnight ago.
normal.cn: 这封信两周前就到了。

abstract.en: A fortnight is two weeks holding hands.
abstract.cn: 两星期就是手拉着手的两个星期。

abstract.en: British speech folds nights into time.
abstract.cn: 英式英语把夜晚折叠成时间。

abstract.en: Fourteen days can change a whole life.
abstract.cn: 十四天可以改变一生。

examples.en: We will meet in a fortnight.
examples.cn: 我们两周后见面。

examples.en: She returned a fortnight later.
examples.cn: 她两周后回来了。

examples.en: They took a fortnight's holiday.
examples.cn: 他们休了两周假。

dict_mnemonic.text: fortnight 来自 fourteen nights：十四个夜晚，就是十四天，也就是两星期。

root: 由古英语 feowertyne niht（十四个夜晚）缩合而成，核心义「十四天」。

sensesIntro.en: Fortnight means two weeks, a two-week interval, or a two-week holiday.
sensesIntro.cn: fortnight 意为两星期、每两周或两周假期。

core.en: Fourteen nights joined into one block of time.
core.cn: 十四个夜晚连成的一整块时间。

branches.en: Fourteen days pass as one unit.
branches.cn: 十四天作为一个单位过去。

branches.en: The unit returns on a schedule.
branches.cn: 这个时间单位按计划重复。

branches.en: The unit becomes a holiday.
branches.cn: 这个时间单位变成一段假期。

branches.en: Two weeks can be time or freedom.
branches.cn: 两周既可以是时间，也可以是自由。

branches.en: A length and a rhythm share one word.
branches.cn: 一段时间与一种节奏共用一个词。

intro.en: Fortnight builds a small family of two-week and night words.
intro.cn: fortnight 构成表示两周与夜晚的小词族。

latinIntro.en: Fortnight is Germanic; Latin duae hebdomades, two weeks, is only a semantic parallel.
latinIntro.cn: fortnight 属日耳曼语；拉丁语 duae hebdomades（两周）只是语义对应词。

items.exampleCN: 这是每两周一次的会议。

items.example: The old phrase was fourteen nights.
items.exampleCN: 古语说法是十四个夜晚。

definition_en: having good luck, happening by good chance, or bringing luck
core_image: 暴雨刚停，赶路的人正好遇到一辆顺风车
scene: 他很幸运，赶上了最后一班车。He was fortunate to catch the last bus.
sceneCN: 这里 fortunate 是「幸运的」（第 1 个义项）；句意：他很幸运，赶上了最后一班车。

senses.title: Having good luck
senses.definition: having good luck
senses.definitionCN: 拥有好运气
senses.example: He was fortunate to catch the last bus.
senses.exampleCN: 他很幸运，赶上了最后一班车。
senses.why: This is the central personal sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是核心的个人义项。

senses.title: A lucky escape
senses.definition: happening by good chance despite risk
senses.definitionCN: 虽有风险却因好机会而发生
senses.example: It was a fortunate escape from the fire.
senses.exampleCN: 那是一次从火灾中的侥幸逃脱。
senses.why: Luck is felt most when danger passes.
senses.whyCN: 危险过去时，运气最容易被感受到。

senses.title: Auspicious
senses.definition: believed to bring good luck
senses.definitionCN: 被认为会带来好运
senses.example: They chose a fortunate date for the wedding.
senses.exampleCN: 他们为婚礼选了一个吉利的日期。
senses.why: Objects and dates can carry luck too.
senses.whyCN: 物品和日期也能承载运气。

intro.en: Fortunate comes from the Latin word for luck, fortuna.
intro.cn: fortunate 来自拉丁语中表示运气的词 fortuna。

items.en: Fortuna meant chance, luck, or fate.
items.cn: fortuna 意为机缘、运气或命运。

items.en: Fortunate entered English from Latin.

items.en: It described people with good luck.

items.en: It also described lucky escapes.

normal.en: It was a fortunate escape from the fire.
normal.cn: 那是一次从火灾中的侥幸逃脱。

normal.en: They chose a fortunate date for the wedding.
normal.cn: 他们为婚礼选了一个吉利的日期。

normal.en: She was fortunate enough to find work.
normal.cn: 她有幸找到了工作。

normal.en: We are less fortunate than we think.
normal.cn: 我们并没有自己想的那么幸运。

abstract.en: The fortunate person still has to open the door.
abstract.cn: 幸运的人仍然得自己开门。

abstract.en: Luck looks like a plan from the outside.

abstract.en: A fortunate escape teaches humility.

definition_en: luck, the force that decides events, wealth, or a large amount of money

scene: 好运终于来了。Good fortune finally arrived.

senses.title: Luck

senses.title: Fate

senses.title: A large sum

definition_en: toward the front, a player near the front, or moving toward the future
core_image: 一个箭头朝前指着，队伍顺着箭头方向移动

definition_en: the base of a building or idea, or an organization that gives money
core_image: 深埋地下的一层混凝土，把整栋楼托在半空
scene: 这座桥的地基非常坚固。The foundation of the bridge is very strong.
sceneCN: 这里 foundation 是「地基」（第 1 个义项）；句意：这座桥的地基非常坚固。

senses.title: The base
senses.definition: the solid base on which a building or idea rests
senses.definitionCN: 建筑或思想所依托的坚固基础
senses.example: The foundation of the bridge is very strong.
senses.exampleCN: 这座桥的地基非常坚固。
senses.why: This is the basic base sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是最基本的基础义项。

senses.title: An organization that gives money
senses.definition: an organization that supports research or charity with money

senses.example: The foundation funds medical research.
senses.exampleCN: 该基金会资助医学研究。
senses.why: A fund rests on a base of money.

senses.title: The act of founding

senses.why: The base and the act share one word.
senses.whyCN: 基础与创建行为共用一个词。

definition_en: a border or structure, to put a picture in a frame, to plan, or to make someone seem guilty

senses.title: A border or structure

intro.en: Freeway is a transparent American compound built from free and way, coined in the early twentieth century.
intro.cn: freeway 是一个结构透明的美式复合词，由 free 与 way 合成，出现于二十世纪初。

items.en: Old English frēo meant free, and weġ meant way or road; both are native Germanic words.
items.cn: 古英语 frēo 意为「自由的」，weġ 意为「路」；两者都是日耳曼语源的本族词。

items.en: By the Middle English period free and way were common words, and compounds such as pathway and highway had already appeared.
items.cn: 到中古英语时期，free 与 way 已是常用词，pathway、highway 等复合词也已出现。

items.en: The compound freeway is generally dated to the early twentieth century in the United States, when planning words for new motor roads were being coined.
items.cn: 一般认为复合词 freeway 于二十世纪初在美国出现，当时人们正为新的汽车道路创造规划用语。

items.en: The free element emphasized that these roads were to be traveled without paying tolls, distinguishing them from toll roads and parkways.
items.cn: 词中的 free 强调这类道路通行时不缴通行费，以此区别于收费公路（toll road）与景观大道（parkway）。

items.en: Today freeway is the standard American term for such roads; British English uses motorway, and highway in America is a broader term.
items.cn: 如今 freeway 是美国对这类道路的标准称呼；英式英语用 motorway，美式 highway 则是更宽泛的说法。

normal.en: Compare highway: high way is a high-grade road; free way is a toll-free road.
normal.cn: 对比 highway：high way 是高级公路；free way 是免费公路。

normal.en: British motorway uses motor, American freeway uses free; pair the two terms.
normal.cn: 英式 motorway 用 motor，美式 freeway 用 free；把两个词配对记。

normal.en: Freeway traffic moves fast because there are no lights or booths to slow it.
normal.cn: 高速车流之所以快，因为没有红绿灯和收费亭减速。

normal.en: Family of ways: pathway, highway, freeway, throughway — all end in way.
normal.cn: way 词族：pathway、highway、freeway、throughway —— 都以 way 结尾。

abstract.en: Picture an open gateless road stretching to the horizon: nothing blocks you.
abstract.cn: 想象一条没有闸口、直伸天际的开阔大路：没有任何东西拦你。

abstract.en: Feel the sense of gliding freely forward, lane after lane.
abstract.cn: 体会一条接一条车道上自由滑行向前的感觉。

abstract.en: Link free with freedom of movement: the road gives your car freedom.
abstract.cn: 把 free 与行动自由相连：这条路给了汽车自由。

examples.en: We took the freeway south to avoid the slow coastal roads.
examples.cn: 我们走高速公路向南，避开了缓慢的沿海公路。

examples.en: An accident near the exit left the freeway jammed for miles.
examples.cn: 出口附近的事故让高速公路堵了好几英里。

examples.en: Her new job meant a long daily drive on the freeway.
examples.cn: 她的新工作意味着每天要开车在高速路上跑很长的路。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「福瑞维」——福（free 免费而）瑞（顺利）地维（维持）高速通行，谐音联想帮助记住 free 与 way 的组合，并非真实词源。

root: freeway 为复合词：free（古英语 frēo，自由的）+ way（古英语 weġ，道路）。free 表示「免费的、不受阻碍的」，强调通行不缴费；作为词根 free 还见于 freedom、freely，way 还见于 highway、pathway。

sensesIntro.en: From the concrete road itself, the senses widen to the network and the traffic it carries.
sensesIntro.cn: 义项从具体的道路本身出发，扩展到道路网络与其承载的车流。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a wide gateless road where vehicles move freely at speed
core.cn: 核心意象：一条没有闸口的宽阔大路，车辆畅快飞驰

branches.en: the physical multilane road with no toll gates
branches.cn: 设有多个车道、不收费的具体道路

branches.en: free movement of traffic implies fast links between cities
branches.cn: 车流畅行意味着城市之间快速连通

branches.en: the network stands for modern urban life
branches.cn: 路网被视为现代都市生活的象征

branches.en: the lanes and vehicles form a flowing stream
branches.cn: 车道与车辆汇成奔涌的车流

branches.en: congestion on the artery shapes daily commuting
branches.cn: 干道上的拥堵塑造着日常通勤

intro.en: Freeway is a plain compound; the pattern free/way helps you read other road words.
intro.cn: freeway 是个朴素的复合词；free/way 的构词模式能帮你读懂其他道路类词。

latinIntro.en: The two elements are native Germanic, so there are no Latin cognates to list.
latinIntro.cn: 两个构词成分都是日耳曼本族词，因此没有可列的拉丁同源词。

definition_en: to become ice, to stop something, to feel very cold, or a period of frost
core_image: 寒夜里湖面慢慢结出一层白冰
scene: 湖面在一夜寒风中冻住了。The lake froze in the cold night wind.
sceneCN: 这里 freeze 是「结冰」（第 1 个义项）；句意：湖面在一夜寒风中冻住了。

senses.title: To turn into ice
senses.definition: to become hard and solid because of cold
senses.definitionCN: 因寒冷而变硬变实
senses.example: The lake froze in the cold night wind.
senses.exampleCN: 湖面在一夜寒风中冻住了。
senses.why: This is the basic sense of water turning to ice.
senses.whyCN: 这是水变成冰的基本义项。

senses.title: To stop something
senses.definition: to stop money, prices, or activity from moving
senses.definitionCN: 使资金、价格或活动停止变动
senses.example: The company froze all new spending.
senses.exampleCN: 公司冻结了所有新的开支。
senses.why: Something frozen cannot move, so stopping movement borrows the word.
senses.whyCN: 冻住的东西不能动，于是「停止」也借用了这个词。

senses.title: To feel very cold
senses.definition: to feel extremely cold
senses.definitionCN: 感到极度寒冷
senses.example: My hands are freezing in this wind.
senses.exampleCN: 这阵风里我的双手冻僵了。
senses.why: The body feels like it is turning to ice.
senses.whyCN: 身体感觉像要结成冰。

senses.title: A period of frost
senses.definition: a time when the weather stays below freezing
senses.definitionCN: 天气持续低于冰点的时期
senses.example: The freeze lasted for two weeks.
senses.exampleCN: 冰冻期持续了两周。
senses.why: The verb turned into a noun for the cold period itself.
senses.whyCN: 动词转化为名词，指寒冷期本身。

branches.en: Spending stops as if held by ice.

branches.en: Hands lose their warmth in the wind.

items.example: Put the meat in the freezer.

Seeds are kept in deep freeze.

definition_zh: 冰柜；冰箱冷冻室；冷藏库
definition_en: a machine or room used for keeping food frozen at a very low temperature
core_image: 一台低沉嗡嗡作响的柜子，门一开便涌出白雾，里面的食物冻得梆硬
scene: 清晨的厨房里，妈妈打开柜门取出一袋冻豆子，白雾扑面而来。She took the last bag of peas out of the freezer.
sceneCN: 这里 freezer 是「冰柜；冷冻室」（第 1 个义项：低温冷冻食物的设备）；句意是她从冰柜里取出最后一袋豌豆。

collocations.phrase: take something out of the freezer
a chest freezer with a broken seal

derivatives.zh: 基础动词，义为「结冰；冷冻；冻结」，freezer 由其加名词后缀 -er 构成
freeze 的过去分词转形容词，义为「冰冻的；冷冻的」

senses.title: A device that keeps food frozen
senses.definition: a household appliance or a compartment that stores food below freezing point
senses.definitionCN: 把食物储存在冰点以下的家用电器或冰箱的一个隔层
senses.example: The freezer hums quietly in the corner of the kitchen.
senses.exampleCN: 冰柜在厨房角落里低声嗡嗡运转。
senses.why: The verb freeze names the action, and -er names the agent or tool that performs it.
senses.whyCN: 动词 freeze 表示「冷冻」这一动作，后缀 -er 表示执行该动作的工具。

senses.title: An industrial cold-storage room
senses.definition: a large room or storehouse where goods are kept at freezing temperatures
senses.definitionCN: 把货物保存在冷冻温度下的大房间或仓库
senses.example: Workers wear thick coats inside the meat freezer.
senses.exampleCN: 工人在肉类冷藏库里要穿上厚外套。
senses.why: The same tool-word scales up from a home appliance to an industrial chamber.
senses.whyCN: 同一个工具名词由家用电器放大为工业级冷冻库房。

senses.title: A stockpile of frozen food
senses.titleCN: 冻品储备；冰柜里的存粮
senses.definition: the supply of frozen food kept in such a device, spoken of as a whole
senses.definitionCN: 存放在冷冻设备里的冻品总量，被当作一个整体来谈论
senses.example: A well-stocked freezer saved us from cooking every night.
senses.exampleCN: 存满冻品的冰柜让我们不必每晚做饭。
senses.why: From naming the container, usage shifts to what the container holds.
senses.whyCN: 由指称容器转指容器所装之物，即冰柜里的冻品储备。

intro.en: Freezer is a modern agent noun: the old verb freeze plus the tool suffix -er.
intro.cn: freezer 是一个现代的工具名词：古老动词 freeze 加上工具后缀 -er。

items.en: The verb goes back to Proto-Germanic *frezaną, generally reconstructed as meaning to freeze, related to frost.
items.cn: 该动词可追溯至原始日耳曼语 *frezaną，一般认为重构义为「结冰」，与 frost（霜）同源。

items.en: Old English frēosan meant to freeze, used of water, weather, and people who felt cold.
items.cn: 古英语 frēosan 意为「结冰；冻僵」，既可用于水与天气，也可用于感到寒冷的人。

items.en: Middle English fresen kept the same core meaning and produced the past participle frozen.
items.cn: 中古英语 fresen 保持同一核心词义，并产生了过去分词 frozen。

items.en: With ice cutting and early refrigeration, agent nouns like freezer appeared for machines and cold rooms.
items.cn: 随着采冰业与早期制冷技术的出现，freezer 这类工具名词开始指机器与低温库房。

items.en: Electric household refrigeration made freezer a normal kitchen word, at first for the freezer compartment of a fridge.
items.cn: 家用电制冷的普及让 freezer 成为寻常厨房用词，最初指冰箱的冷冻室。

items.en: Today freezer covers both the standalone chest freezer and the freezer compartment inside a refrigerator.
items.cn: 如今 freezer 既指独立的卧式冰柜，也指冰箱内置的冷冻室。

note.en: Freezer belongs to the cold chain of words; keep it apart from fridge, which cools rather than freezes.
note.cn: freezer 属于一组「冷」词；注意与 fridge 区分——fridge 是冷藏而非冷冻。

entries.definitionCN: 极冷的；冰点以下的，与 freezer 同根

entries.definitionCN: 旧式用冰块降温的柜子，是 freezer 的前身概念

normal.cn: frozen food 存在 freezer 里；两个词形义互相印证。

normal.en: Family of cold words: freeze, frost, frozen, freezer.
normal.cn: 冷词家族：freeze、frost、frozen、freezer。

abstract.cn: 想象掀开柜盖时白雾滚滚涌出的画面。

examples.en: A power cut at night quietly thawed everything in the freezer.
examples.cn: 夜里停电，冰柜里的东西悄悄化冻了。
